Definition: A toggle button that is one choice in a group. Only one radio button in a group can be picked at a time.
A control on a page that holds other controls. When it holds radio buttons, it makes sure only one of them is picked, and it handles the arrow keys for them.
The class a Grouping comes from. It is the part that keeps only one button picked.
The Quorum class that every on/off button comes from. RadioButton and Checkbox are both kinds of ToggleButton.
Moving between the choices in a group with the arrow keys instead of the Tab key. The group gets one Tab stop, and the arrows change the choice.
